outcome: composite maternal adverse outcomes (admission to ICU, blood transfusion, uterine rupture, unplanned hysterectomy)
cohort: The study included 455,284 women with liveborn singleton gestation who underwent Trial of Labor After Cesarean (TOLAC) at 23-41 weeks' gestation, using U.S. birth data from 2014-2018.
finding: In patients undergoing TOLAC, preterm gestational age (23-36 weeks) was associated with a significantly higher risk of composite maternal adverse outcomes compared to term gestational age (37-41 weeks).
